sources.entry: Clocker - macOS app to plan and organize through timezones.

summary.one_liner: Clocker is a macOS menubar app that shows the current time for friends and contacts in different time zones.
summary.what_it_does: Clocker runs as a utility in the macOS menu bar. Its stated purpose is to help you keep track of friends in different time zones. The README says it is written in Swift 5 and is ad-free. It is open to translation help and pull requests. The README is short and does not list detailed features, so specifics beyond time-zone tracking are not described here.
use_cases: check friends' local time across time zones
keep track of remote contacts' time from the menu bar
notable: Written in Swift 5, moved away from Objective-C
caveats: README gives no installation or build instructions
Donations are suggested, and the README links to reviews rather than describing features
